baselineGuide.title: Baseline Setup Guide
baselineGuide.need:
A personal baseline is required
for movement pattern analysis.

step1.title: Prepare Device
step1.desc: Place your phone flat on a desk.

step2.title: Start Baseline
step2.desc: Tap baseline start and collect movement data for about 10 seconds.

step3.title: Complete
step3.desc: Your personal baseline is saved after completion.

baselineGuide.why:
Why baseline is needed?
• Compensates device sensor differences
• Reflects individual hand tremor traits
• Improves condition score consistency
baselineGuide.completedToast: Baseline setup completed. You can now start motion tracking.

confirm.deleteAllLogs:

confirm.resetBaseline:

It will be reset to average values,

instructions.analysisDoneDesc: Keeping recording conditions consistent yields more stable reference indicators.
instructions.analyzingDesc:
Recording movement data to calculate your performance score.
Please stay still for {seconds} seconds.
instructions.baselineStep1: Place your smartphone flat on a desk. (Do not move)
instructions.baselineStep2: Keep the screen facing up in a low-vibration environment.
instructions.baselineStep3: Tap ‘Start Baseline’ to collect movement data for about 10 seconds and set your personal baseline.
instructions.baselineWhy:
Why baseline setup is needed?
• Corrects sensor differences by device
• Reflects individual hand tremor characteristics
• Improves consistency of future condition scores
instructions.preStep1: Sit down and rest your arm comfortably on the desk.
instructions.preStep2: Hold the smartphone lightly with one hand and keep still.
instructions.preStep3: Place it flat with the screen facing upward.
instructions.preStep4: When ready, tap the start button below.
